title: fix(core): isolate facilitator lifecycle hook errors
quote: The worst case is afterSettle: settlement has already executed onchain, but a throwing hook falls into the settle() catch ... and rethrows, so the caller sees an error for a payment that actually moved money.

title: Document facilitator hook error isolation behavior
quote: Advisory hooks (onAfterVerify, onVerifyFailure, onAfterSettle, onSettleFailure) now isolate errors — a throwing hook is logged and skipped instead of changing the verify/settle outcome. Gate hooks (onBeforeVerify, onBeforeSettle) still fail closed.

title: chore(rust): bump solana-keychain to main (ed68ba3)
quote: Re-pins solana-keychain from 44b479d to ed68ba3 (current keychain main). That pulls in solana-keychain#344 ... and #347 ... There are no source changes.

title: fix(ts): preflight server broadcasts at confirmed commitment
quote: The TS charge and subscription servers simulate at confirmed, but broadcastTransaction called sendTransaction without a preflightCommitment. That means the node default, finalized, applied ... surfpool 1.7 ... now honors preflightCommitment.

title: fix(tempo): isolate session close from resource request state
quote: Cooperative HTTP session close reused the resource Request retained by SessionManager. Fetch therefore inherited its abort signal and body: cancelling the resource could cancel a later explicit close().

title: fix(client): preserve Request state in payment retries
quote: When fetch() receives a Request carrying a method and body, a 402 response with a populated response.url currently turns the paid retry into a URL-only request. A POST can therefore be retried as a GET without its body.

title: feat(identity-linking): permit email matching when the issuer is the mailbox authority
quote: businesses MAY resolve a grant to an existing account by email only when ... they have independently established that the issuer is the mailbox authority for the domain ... Security Considerations: the Cross-IdP bullet now names this exception and its residual risks (address recycling and reassignment).

title: Cursor Confirms Anthropic Claude Code Extension Compromised
quote: A malicious actor used access to Cursor's marketplace to publish a tampered extension targeting Cursor's users, we were not involved with building, publishing or hosting this.
